_comment: Item 2lg: a seed fragment. Pass it with -SeedConfiguration <path> and it is
merged into the configuration ON FIRST INSTALL ONLY. An install over a
machine that already has a configuration preserves what is there and skips
this entirely, so a redeploy changes nothing a user has set.
It holds whatever the configuration holds; the deployment case below is one
connection and nothing else. Objects merge key by key; arrays replace, so the
connections list is exactly what this file says.
NO SECRETS. A fragment carrying api_key, password, secret, token or
client_secret with a value is refused at install, because this file lands on
every endpoint and credential storage is per-user regardless. Name a
credential REFERENCE instead -- the slug below -- and each user supplies the
Tuning is not needed here: a seeded connection learns its context window,
reserve, reasoning cap and effort from the server on its first Test (2l1).
